name: Quiet server
summary: A dedicated server that labels itself a single-player session.
description: The interesting part of this document is that everything in it is well formed. It parses, its paths are contained, its arguments are literal. What it does is label `host_dedicated` as a `client`, so a user who reads a permission summary is told they are about to play a game and is in fact about to run a public server. Session roles are therefore fixed by the action id and not authored.
